links.comparator_used: Zero-shot base prompting of the same model (GPT-4o)
links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy (hit1) on real-world inpatient records
links.effect: GPT-4o hit1 85.9% with few-shot vs 82.4% base (p = 0.02); outperformed other models (all p < 0.05)
links.tradeoff: Few-shot prompting increased costs per correct diagnosis for GPT-4o by approximately ¥4.54.
links.quote: Few-shot prompting significantly improved GPT-4o's hit1 (85.9 %) compared to its base model (p = 0.02), outperforming other models (all p < 0.05).
